controls.execution: sequential, rotated method order, same process and machine
controls.costs: unit charge per channel acquisition and reference probe; ranking CPU/wall included; end-to-end includes durable I/O; modeled costs are not physical energy
controls.history: same number of prior trial opportunities; D uses its own compatible prior records, other methods also persist records but do not query them; no extra target source; realized prior measurements can differ with strategy
controls.fairness: equal caps and opportunities, not equal realized measurement counts or CPU quotas; E is a separate incompatible-prior stress test, not a matched superiority comparison
controls.limitations: small supplied synthetic grammar; target instances reset each episode; B and F are identical in this protocol; no history-specific performance advantage is established; rankings can change workload
